claim_steps: Choose the On-Demand plan (Start free) at platform.inworld.ai/billing.

Use the up-to-70-min TTS or 400-min STT allowance and check the actual Billing balance. Inference is charged per token from the shared credit balance at the selected model rate; confirm free-credit eligibility and premium-model payment requirements before calling it.

social_proof.text: On-Demand is great for testing and comes with up to 70 minutes of TTS or 400 minutes of STT for free.
social_proof.title: Pricing | Inworld AI
Inworld pricing — shared credit balance
social_proof.text: Credits are a dollar-denominated balance used to pay for usage across all Inworld products. LLM Inference bills per token from the same credits as every other product.

summary: Inworld AI's On-Demand plan includes up to 70 minutes of TTS (or 400 minutes of STT) for free, with voice and Inworld Inference access. Usage is metered: current pricing and billing describe a shared credit balance across TTS, STT, Inference and Realtime rather than a blanket separately billed LLM exclusion. Confirm your actual balance and model eligibility; this does not promise unlimited inference or a fixed free LLM token allowance. Some premium LLMs require a card and a credit purchase or paid-plan upgrade even with an existing balance. Professional voice cloning on On-Demand also requires a payment method.
